what: The rest of the chips used turned round on a Surrounded field located and mended (issue #846; docs/rom/chips-code.md, A chip used turned round, the rest): BN4's moved code calls BN6_ENEMY_DIRECTION with objects whose flip it left 0 (answered by MegaMan's facing from XC4_CODE and XN_BN4_CODE); BN6_ROW_PANEL_ACROSS's two searches by the alliance (BN6_ROW_ACROSS_WAY 0x08016178, BN6_ROW_ACROSS_WAY2 0x08016192, Meteors); BN6's side reads in SandWrm (BN6_SANDWORM_FLIP 0x080E0546, BN6_SANDWORM_FLIP2 0x080E088A), BurnSqr (BN6_BURNSQR_START 0x080BC8C2), TenguMan (BN6_TENGU_DASH 0x080BB5FE, BN6_TENGU_DIVE 0x080BB6CA), AirRaid (BN6_AIRRAID_EDGE 0x080D4FF2), Magnum (BN6_MAGNUM_START 0x080BCC16) and BlastMan (BN6_BLASTMAN_START 0x080BA8D0); BN4's in SeekBom (BN4_SEEKBOM_AHEAD 0x080DEF5C), PitRng (BN4_PITRNG_EDGE 0x080E99FE) and GutsMan (BN4_GUTSMAN_EDGE 0x080D07E2), hooked where they were moved (src/emu/turned_aim.c). Left as the originals' own, read in BN6's, BN5's and BN4's code: FlshBom, Magnum's timing, Voltz, Astroid, CloudMan's 50, CosmoMan, MokoRus, BigHamr's random panels, Hole. Scenarios battle-turned/{burnsqr,blastman,panlsht,meteors,seekbom}, seen to fail on the build before.
